content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hi,

I hope you’re well. Before I sign the agreement, I’d like to suggest a few small adjustments for clarity and fairness:

- The current clause requires the contractor to perform any additional services the client reasonably requests at no extra charge. This could lead to unlimited unpaid work. I propose that additional services be performed only upon a written change order signed by both parties, with compensation at the rates agreed in that change order.
- The clause allowing unlimited revisions until the client is fully satisfied gives no limit on revision requests, which may consume excessive time and resources. I suggest limiting revisions to up to three (3) rounds per deliverable, with any extra revisions handled through a separate change order and billed at the agreed rates.
- The “Revision allowance: unlimited” wording similarly permits endless revisions without extra compensation. I recommend changing this to “Revision allowance: up to three (3) revision rounds per deliverable; additional revisions will be billed at the agreed hourly rate.”

Please let me know if these modifications work for you. I look forward to finalizing the agreement.

Thanks and best regards,
